role: Coverage gate: parses `xccov --files-for-target Emuqu.app` per-file report and enforces overall, logic (non-Views) and Views-only line-coverage floors.
toplevel: Sources lib/preflight.sh. Usage <xcresult> [min_overall]; wrong argc -> exit 64. Floors: arg2 or MIN_COVERAGE env or .ci/min_coverage.txt (44) else 16; MIN_LOGIC_COVERAGE env or .ci/min_coverage_logic.txt (45) else 30; MIN_VIEWS_COVERAGE env or .ci/min_coverage_views.txt (43.5) else 0. Missing bundle -> exit 66. Temp file via gate_mktemp; xccov errors ignored; empty report -> exit 65. Python sums covered/total for rows matching `/path.swift N pct% (c/t)`; no rows -> 65; logic excludes paths containing /Sources/Views/; SKIP_OVERALL_COVERAGE=1 / SKIP_LOGIC_COVERAGE=1 turn those floor failures into SKIP lines; views floor always enforced. Summary echoed and appended to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY; non-zero Python status -> exit 1. Invoked only by run_tests_with_coverage.sh (check_gates_wired exempts it).

flags.text: A missing floor file silently falls back to hard-coded floors (16/30/0) far below the committed 44/45/43.5, and env vars SKIP_LOGIC_COVERAGE/MIN_* override the committed floors with no record.
Header says the real figure is ~16% and the overall floor is derived from it; the committed floor is 44.
run_tests_with_coverage.sh says a unit-only run's coverage is 'REPORTED but not GATED', but check_coverage.sh still enforces the views floor (43.5) on that run; only overall and logic are skipped.
The 'logic' bucket excludes only paths containing /Sources/Views/, so SwiftUI views under Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Views/ count as logic, which the header defines as code unit tests can reach.
